title: Data Engineer
text:
Nordhavn Logistics is looking for a Data Engineer to join our analytics platform team in Madrid. The role is on-site, five days a week.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines.
- Model data in our warehouse for the BI team.
- Ensure data quality and documentation.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
- 2+ years of experience as a data engineer.
- Strong Python and SQL.
- Experience with Apache Spark and Apache Airflow.
- Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery.
- Spanish and English (B2 or higher).

Nice to have
- Kafka.
- dbt.
- Experience with Terraform.
